recovery.title: Creatine
recovery.desc: 5g daily with warm water or tea.

recovery.title: Salt & Water
recovery.desc: Warm water + sea salt pinch when dragging. Then a 15-min nasal-breathing walk.

tips: Sleep is the training session. When work stress spikes, protect it.
No set goes to failure. Sets 1–2 stop 2 reps short, set 3 stops 1 rep short. If you could do 3+ more, the weight is too light.
Lower day: warm up on the bike, not the treadmill. Start easy, finish moderate. Save your legs for the leg press.
Zone 2 check on the incline walk: nose breathing, full sentences. If you are gasping, lower the incline. If it feels like a stroll, raise it.
Progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at 1–2 RIR, add the smallest weight jump next week.
Recomp runs on protein: 1.6–2.2 g per kg of bodyweight daily, spread over 3–4 meals.
Interval day: run the Bike Intervals routine today. If the work week was brutal, skip it. Recovery beats one more session.
